svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three layers. Global: the customer browser calls Central. Region: Central calls Atlas, Cargo and the HTTP proxy cluster; Atlas sends state webhooks back to Central; Cargo asks Atlas for machines. The WireGuard gateway and IPv6 router are also regional services. Hosts: Atlas calls Metal on each host over mutual TLS, and WG Mesh joins the hosts with WireGuard tunnels. VMs run Pilot and the site.

text.tspan: Metal hosts · many in each region
Cargo, proxy, gateway and router run in service VMs on Metal hosts
mutual TLS · VM changes · host sync every 10 s
